sources.title: Official Mistral-Large-Instruct-2411 model card
sources.evidence: Explicitly describes the exact November checkpoint as a dense 123B LLM extending Instruct-2407, with multilingual text, coding, native function calling, JSON output, 128k context and the Mistral Research License. General reasoning claims and step-by-step prompting examples do not establish a dedicated thinking mode.

sources.title: Mistral Large 2.1 official legacy documentation and weights table
sources.evidence: Identifies mistral-large-2411, version 24.11 and November 18, 2024. The page's fetched HTML includes the exact Instruct-2411 weights row with separate Parameters (B)=123 and Active (B)=123 columns, MRL and 128k context. The table was inspected in the page's serialized content, which the web text extractor omits.

sources.title: Mistral Large 2.1 official documentation, Markdown
sources.evidence: Fetched successfully via Python urllib. Explicitly gives API mistral-large-2411, release date 2024-11-18, version 24.11, text input/output, function calling, 128k context, MRL and the exact open-weight checkpoint. Document QnA is a listed serving feature, while the native input modality remains text.

sources.title: Official Instruct-2411 Transformers configuration at inspected revision
sources.evidence: Public configuration declares MistralForCausalLM, model_type=mistral, 88 layers, hidden size 12288, 96 attention heads, 8 KV heads, head dimension 128, intermediate size 28672, untied embeddings and max_position_embeddings=131072. No expert-routing or vision configuration is present.

sources.title: Official Instruct-2411 native parameters configuration at inspected revision
sources.evidence: The publicly accessible native configuration independently gives dim=12288, n_layers=88, n_heads=96, n_kv_heads=8, hidden_dim=28672, vocab_size=32768 and max_position_embeddings=131072. It matches the inspected Transformers configuration. No weights were downloaded.

sources.title: November 18, 2024 announcement, Mistral Large 24.11 update section
sources.evidence: The dated announcement's One more thing section separately releases the Mistral Large text-model update as Mistral Large 24.11 on Hugging Face under MRL, improving long-context understanding, system prompts and function calling over 24.07. Its API-name sentence mistakenly repeats pixtral-large-latest; the exact text-model identifier is instead established by the official documentation and changelog. Pixtral's vision encoder and 124B total are not transferred to this model.

sources.title: Mistral official changelog, November 18, 2024
sources.evidence: The November 18 entry explicitly announces Mistral Large 2.1 (mistral-large-2411) and separately Pixtral Large (pixtral-large-2411), confirming the exact release identity and date.

sources.title: Mistral AI Research License, MRL-0.1
sources.evidence: License linked by the exact checkpoint card. It grants conditional use, modification and redistribution for research purposes; uses outside the agreement require separate licensing. This establishes a restricted research license rather than Apache or unrestricted open-source terms.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata and hosted safetensors aggregate
sources.evidence: Public API reports revision ba78820945ae22361b0274cf0ae6d696c967c1a4, gated=false, BF16 safetensors aggregate 122610069504 and lists native plus Transformers weight shards. The repository creation timestamp predates launch and is not used as the release date. The aggregate was not independently reconciled with every tensor, so the report retains Mistral's directly disclosed nominal 123B count.

name.note: Official name mapped explicitly to mistral-large-2411; distinct from July's Large 2.0 and the separate Pixtral Large release.

developer.note: Mistral AI publishes the model and announcement; Mistral is the catalog's normalized developer name.

family.note: The exact card and announcement place version 24.11 in the Mistral Large series as an update to 24.07.

release_date.note: The dated launch and exact-model documentation agree. Later cloud-partner availability and the earlier Hugging Face repository creation are not the public release date.

open_weights.note: The exact checkpoint was released for self-deployment under MRL. Restricted licensing does not negate weight availability; no full weight payload was downloaded.

license.note: The card links MRL-0.1. Research use is restricted by that agreement; commercial self-deployment requires separate licensing.

parameters_b.note: Developer-disclosed nominal total in billions for the exact November checkpoint. This is not presented as an exact tensor count; the separate HF aggregate is 122.610069504B and was not independently reconciled against every tensor.

active_parameters_b.note: The official Instruct-2411 weights row independently labels Active (B)=123. This retains the source's nominal precision and is not inferred from dense architecture or equality with the total. No finer activation-count convention is stated.

architecture.note: The exact model card explicitly says dense. Its native and MistralForCausalLM configurations corroborate a Transformer language model with grouped-query attention and no MoE routing; no later Mistral Large architecture is transferred.

context_window.note: Both exact checkpoint configurations specify max_position_embeddings=131072, resolving the advertised 128k native context. This does not claim a current hosted endpoint's enforced limit or operational availability.

modalities.note: Official exact-model Markdown explicitly lists text input/output, and the announcement calls this the text model. Document QnA support does not establish native PDF or image input; those modalities are not added.

reasoning.note: Primary sources discuss ordinary reasoning ability and step-by-step prompting but do not explicitly establish dedicated native thinking support or declare its absence. Clear the unsupported baseline false rather than infer true from general reasoning claims.

tool_call.note: The exact card explicitly describes native function calling and demonstrates calls and tool results; the November announcement specifically highlights improved function calling.

description.value: November 2024 Mistral Large 2.1 instruction model with multilingual text, code generation and native function calling
description.note: Replace the undated flagship claim with an exact-revision description supported by the developer's release and card, without implying dedicated reasoning support.

patch.description: November 2024 Mistral Large 2.1 instruction model with multilingual text, code generation and native function calling
patch.notes: Mistral directly discloses nominal 123B total and 123B active parameters in the exact Instruct-2411 weights row. Both native and Transformers configurations specify 131072 context tokens. Dedicated thinking support remains unverified; general reasoning claims do not establish that capability. The released weights use the restricted Mistral Research License.

summary: All 14 fields reviewed for the exact November 2024 variant. Add developer-disclosed nominal 123B total and independently labeled 123B active parameters, dense architecture and Mistral Research License; replace the generic description and clear unsupported reasoning=false to null. Confirm November 18 release, 131072 native context, text-only modalities, open weights and native function calling. The announcement's repeated Pixtral API-name typo is resolved by exact-model documentation and changelog. No weight payloads or access gates were used. Dedicated thinking support remains unverified.
